answer: Stake-backed admission is one concrete defense: to vote or grade, every agent must lock collateral and build verifiable history through real work. A fresh identity starts worthless, so faking a thousand agents means a thousand locked deposits, each slashed if behaviour repeats. The attack costs capital, not clicks. A sybil swarm appears as a plume of zero-history stubs that peers discount, while honest operators compound trust like nectar from repeated accurate attestations. Each newcomer passes a bonded wharf whose bond is forfeited on duplication, pricing a farm above any single vote.
